Name: Creator
Description: You learn the Artisanal Training Technique. You must meet its prerequisites.

Name: Discoverer
Description: You start the game with a Climber’s Kit, Adventurer’s Belt, and 2 Medicinal Supplies.

Name: Dilettante
Description: You start the game with a Disguise Kit, Tinker’s Kit, and two sets of Basic Clothing in a style or outfit of your choice.

Name: Journeyman
Description: You start the game with a Crafting Toolset and a total of 9 Level 1 Wood, Leather, Cloth, and/or Metal raw materials.

Name: Herbalist
Description: You start the game with a Mixology Set and 9 Level 1 Medicinal raw materials.

Name: Entertainer
Description: You start the game with a Musical Instrument of your choice, 2 bottles of Level 1 Alcohol, and 5 Gold.

Name: Fisher
Description: You start the game with a Fishing Kit, 2 bottles of Level 1 Alcohol, and 3 large fish.

Name: Traveler
Description: You start the game with a Small Cart and 2 Gold.

Name: Wanderer
Description: You start the game with 2 bottles of Level 1 Alcohol and 8 Gold.

Name: Heirloom
Description: You start the game with an heirloom weapon or suit of armor of a type of your choice. The heirloom may be used as a base item for a Masterwork Enhancement, and requires 1 fewer raw material to enhance in this way. The heirloom has no value to anyone else but you, and any Masterwork Enhancements on it only function when wielded or worn by you.

Name: Professional
Description: You learn the Profession Technique. You must meet its prerequisites.

Name: Storied
Description: Common folk are likely to give you the benefit of the doubt and offer you simple supplies. Your drinks are often on the house.

Name: Rank and Title
Description: As a member in an organization, you have a small amount of clout and resources you can tap into. You usually have to perform some service to the organization in exchange, depending on your request.

Name: Well-Read
Description: When you play a card for any Academics flip, you may treat its suit as being a Spade instead of its normal suit.

Name: Magic Trick
Description: You can use simple magic to warm or chill a small object you’re holding, create a small light the size of a candle's flame, and/or produce a small shower of sparks in the color(s) of your choice.

Name: Gritty
Description: You heal an extra 1 Shallow Health from getting a full night's rest.

Name: Forethought
Description: After you get a full night's rest, you may draw two extra cards. If you do, discard two cards.

Name: Run On All Fours
Description: For 2 AP you may move 2 + [twice your Speed] meters.

Name: Prehensile
Description: You have a tail or other appendage that can be used to hold, retrieve, store, or manipulate objects as well as a hand, although it does not count as a hand or function as a Held item slot.

Name: Amphibious
Description: You can breathe underwater without penalty.

Name: Night Vision
Description: You can see even in total darkness, although this doesn't help against anything that physically obscures vision such as smoke or fog.

Name: Scavenger
Description: You may eat any organic matter, regardless of how fresh or cooked it is, at no penalty. This does not protect you from any kind of Poison.

Name: Aerial Balance
Description: When you fall, you treat the distance as being 3 meters shorter.

Name: Predator
Description: You have claws or some other feature that makes your natural attacks more deadly. When your hands are empty, you may attack as though you were wielding a Two-Handed Light Melee weapon. This benefits from any Hands slot item that improves your Unarmed attacks, but does not otherwise count as an Unarmed weapon.
